study: F2 WP2.3 slice 1 - two-way range station bias solve-for in BLS-LM (MEAS-08, X-15 bias part)
source_of_predeclaration: docs/assurance/vv-program.md F2 table (WP2.3 row); plan section 9 design 2026-11-03
scope_slice_1: estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm(bias_mode='station_range'): one constant range bias per station of the pass, data-only, eliminated exactly by variable projection (Golub-Pereyra; the bias enters linearly with a constant design column): residual and Jacobian rows of each station have their a-priori-weighted station mean removed, so the LM loop, its acceptance test and the posterior (the Schur-complement marginal of the orbit state) are unchanged in form. The bias estimates are reported in EstimatorStats.station_range_biases_m. Moon-centred and barycentric (two_way_light_time_ssb) passes alike
out_of_scope_slice_1: robust outlier rejection with bias (fails closed)

G1_bias_recovery.rule: noise-free data with known biases +7 m (station 1) and -4 m (station 2): recovered biases within 1 mm

G2_state_recovery.rule: position < 1 cm from an 80 m / 0.02 m/s offset, on the same data

G3_bias_free_model_misfit.rule: the same data fitted without bias_mode leaves a station-mean residual within 2 m of the injected bias on at least one station (evidence the bias is material)

G4_projection_identity.rule: on unbiased data, bias_mode='station_range' returns biases < 1 mm and a state within 1 cm of the bias-free solve

G5_fail_closed.rule: SRIF with bias_mode, bias_mode with solve_for_k_srp, with robust_outlier_rejection, and unknown bias_mode values are rejected; a pass with a single station row is rejected

amendments.new_rule: after removing the first-order frame term Delta_M3 (u_up . v_Moon,SSB)/c the rows agree within 1.5 mm (measured 1.03 mm)
FD step 10 m / 1e-2 m/s, threshold unchanged (measured 7.5e-8)

amendments.as_computed: materiality clause FAIL (0.28 m post-fit RMS; 187 m absorbed position error); recovery clause PASS
amendments.new_rule: zero-delay fit position error > 10 m and post-fit RMS > 1000x the matched fit

amendments.as_computed: the delay is rejected earlier, at RangeRatePhysicsConfig (ValueError)
FAIL (0.088 m pass-mean residual; 676 m absorbed position error)
amendments.new_rule: station-mode fit position error > 10 m and post-fit RMS > 1000x the pass-mode fit

amendments.as_computed: FAIL (BLS position 0.81 m with the column fixed at the a-priori state)
amendments.new_rule: design: the time-tag column is re-evaluated at every linearisation point; thresholds unchanged

amendments.reason: pre-result design review by a peer session (erayh-fd), whose own pre-registration 874865d (G25-G33, StationUplinkRamp/ET design) was superseded by 7a258ad before either ran; ET epochs, resolver fix, SRIF recovery, production Jacobian FD and arc-epoch independence adopted

reject_if: any gate fails as computed, or a frozen default-path baseline changes
scope_slice_1b: estimate_two_way_range_srif(bias_mode='station_range'): the same variable projection in the SRIF residual, scored cost and posterior design; SRIF no longer fails closed for this mode (G5's SRIF clause is superseded by G6)

G6_srif_parity.rule: on the G1 data SRIF recovers the biases within 1 mm and its state agrees with BLS-LM within 1 cm; SRIF and BLS-LM posterior position sigmas agree within 1 percent

scope_slice_2: two_way_light_time_ssb with a nonzero fixed transponder delay d (delay-calibrated half-round-trip convention, as the Moon-centred M3 'fixed_coordinate_time' model): relativistic_light_time.solve_two_way takes transponder_delay_s; the uplink is received at the spacecraft at t2u = t2d - d (a local delay, never an epoch difference), the delay-calibrated range is 0.5 c (tau_down + tau_up)(1 - dD/dt) and the measured interval t3 - t1 = tau_down + d + tau_up sets the midpoint rate epoch; the event partials take the spacecraft position sensitivity and velocity at t2u for the uplink. _pass_context and the scenario loader accept d > 0 with this convention; the raw convention and barycentric counted Doppler with a delay still fail closed

G7_zero_delay_identity.rule: transponder_delay_s=0 reproduces the slice-1 SSB ranges and Jacobian bitwise

G8_delay_effect_parity_with_M3.rule: on the G1 arc with d = 0.05 s, the per-row range change SSB(d) - SSB(0) agrees with the Moon-centred M3 change M3(d) - M3(0) within 1 mm, and the change exceeds 1 m on at least one row

G9_jacobian_fd.rule: the d = 0.05 s range Jacobian matches a central finite difference of the initial state (position step 1 m, velocity step 1e-3 m/s) within 1e-6 relative to the row norm

G10_bls_recovery.rule: BLS-LM on noise-free d = 0.05 s data with the matching model recovers position within 1 cm from the G2 offset; a model with d = 0 leaves an RMS residual above 0.5 m on the same data

G11_fail_closed.rule: the scenario loader accepts transponder_delay_s > 0 with two_way_light_time_ssb, still rejects the raw convention; barycentric counted Doppler with a delay still raises NotImplementedError

results_slice_2.G7: PASS bitwise vs HEAD edc8a0b on 240 rows (ranges and Jacobian)

scope_slice_3: bias_mode='pass_range' in estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm and estimate_two_way_range_srif: one constant range bias per tracking pass, eliminated by the same variable projection as 'station_range'. A pass is a run of one station's rows (time order) with no gap above TWO_WAY_RANGE_PASS_GAP_S = 600 s; passes are numbered from 1 per station. Bias estimates are reported in EstimatorStats.station_range_biases_m keyed by (station id, pass index). Same fail-closed rules as slice 1 (K_SRP, robust rejection, a pass with fewer than two rows)

G12_pass_bias_recovery.rule: noise-free SSB data, station 1 tracked in two passes (0-1200 s, 2400-3600 s) with biases +6 m / -3 m, station 2 one pass with +2 m: BLS-LM and SRIF recover every pass bias within 1 mm and position within 1 cm from the G2 offset

G13_station_model_misfit.rule: the same data fitted with bias_mode='station_range' leave a pass-mean residual magnitude above 1 m on at least one station-1 pass

G14_constant_bias_consistency.rule: on data with station-constant biases (+7 m / -4 m) on the same two-pass geometry, 'pass_range' returns both station-1 pass biases within 1 mm of +7 m

G15_fail_closed.rule: a pass with a single row is rejected; 'pass_range' with solve_for_k_srp or robust_outlier_rejection is rejected; the station-mode behaviour (G1-G6) is unchanged

results_slice_3.G12: PASS (BLS-LM and SRIF, every pass bias within 0.17 mm, position 0.25 mm)

scope_slice_4: bias_mode='station_time_tag' (BLS-LM, SRIF; two_way_light_time_ssb only): per station a constant range bias and a receive time-tag offset b_t, the latter entering linearly through the column g = d(range)/d(t3) (relativistic_light_time.two_way_range_clock_partial), both eliminated by variable projection (a 2x2 weighted group solve). g is evaluated once per solve at the a-priori state (its change with the state, ~|delta rho_dot| x b_t, is neglected) and the linearisation in b_t neglects 0.5 rho_ddot b_t^2. Reported in EstimatorStats.station_range_biases_m and station_time_tag_biases_s by station id. RD-07 (time-tag offset)

G16_time_tag_recovery.rule: noise-free SSB data generated with station clock offsets +1 ms / -2 ms and range biases +7 m / -4 m: BLS-LM and SRIF recover both time tags within 1 microsecond, both range biases within 1 mm and position within 1 cm from the G2 offset

G17_range_only_misfit.rule: the same data fitted with bias_mode='station_range': position error above 10 m or post-fit RMS above 1000x the station_time_tag fit

G18_identity_on_untagged_data.rule: on data without clock offsets (range biases +7 m / -4 m) the time tags are below 1e-8 s and the state within 1 cm of the station_range solve

G19_fail_closed.rule: station_time_tag on a Moon-centred pass, with fewer than three rows on a station, with solve_for_k_srp or with robust_outlier_rejection is rejected

results_slice_4.G16: PASS after the design amendment (BLS position 4.5 mm, tags 0.16 us, biases 0.12 mm; SRIF within the same gates)

scope_slice_5: Ramped uplink core (MEAS-08): relativistic_light_time.UplinkRamp, a piecewise-linear transmit frequency f_T(t) = f_k + fdot_k (t - t_k) on [t_k, t_{k+1}) in pass seconds (TDB from et0; the TT-TDB offset of the ramp epochs, <= 1.7 ms, is neglected), with an analytic integral; counted_doppler(..., uplink_ramp=ramp) returns the Moyer ramped counted Doppler in m/s equivalent: the unramped value minus c/(2 f_ref Tc) integral_{t1 start}^{t1 end} (f_T - f_ref) dt1, and its state partial adds c/(2 f_ref Tc) [(f_T(t1e) - f_ref) d(rt_e)/dx - (f_T(t1s) - f_ref) d(rt_s)/dx]. Scenario/estimator plumbing of ramp tables is a later slice

G20_constant_limit.rule: a ramp with f = f_ref and fdot = 0 reproduces the unramped value and partial bitwise

G21_constant_offset.rule: f = f_ref + 1 kHz, fdot = 0: the change equals -c/(2 f_ref Tc) x 1 kHz x (t1e - t1s) within 1e-12 relative

G22_receive_quadrature_oracle.rule: a three-segment ramp (rates +0.4, -0.25, +0.1 Hz/s, breaks inside the count interval): the correction equals an independent Gauss-Legendre quadrature over receive time of (f_T(t1(t3)) - f_ref) dt1/dt3 (t1 solved at each node, dt1/dt3 by central difference of solved t1) within 1e-6 relative to the correction

G23_partial_fd.rule: ramped partial vs central finite difference of the initial state (10 m / 1e-2 m/s) within 1e-6 of the row norm

G24_fail_closed.rule: a ramp that starts after the transmit epoch t1 of the count start raises ValueError; non-increasing segment epochs or a non-positive frequency raise ValueError

scope_slice_6: Ramp tables in the production counted-Doppler path: RangeRatePhysicsConfig.uplink_ramps (last field, default ()), a tuple of (station name, relativistic_light_time.UplinkRamp) pairs, accepted only with a barycentric counted_doppler_model; the barycentric adapter (counted_doppler_ssb) passes the station's ramp to counted_doppler for generation, residuals and the Jacobian (BLS-LM, SRIF). Stations without a ramp keep the constant uplink. Pass metadata records uplink_ramp_stations only when ramps are set. Scenario-JSON ramp tables are out of scope (they come with real tracking data, F5/F6). PRE-RESULT AMENDMENT (before any slice-6 test ran, after a peer-session review): the table epochs are absolute ET (TDB seconds past J2000), converted per pass to pass seconds (epoch - et0) in the adapter, so arc-by-arc runs with different et0 share one table; scenarios._resolve_range_rate_physics keeps every field except count_interval_s (it rebuilt the config field by field and silently dropped counted_doppler_model, station_state_method and uplink_ramps). A station without a table keeps the constant uplink by design and is visible through uplink_ramp_stations

G25_default_identity.rule: with uplink_ramps=() the generated observations are bitwise equal to the config without the field, and the metadata has no uplink_ramp_stations key

G26_routing.rule: with a ramp on Goldstone only, each generated Goldstone row equals rlt.counted_doppler with that ramp within 1e-12 m/s and each Canberra row equals the unramped value bitwise

G27_bls_recovery_and_materiality.rule: BLS-LM and SRIF on the noise-free ramped data with the ramped config recovers position < 1 cm and velocity < 1e-5 m/s from the G2 offset; the unramped config at the truth misfits the Goldstone rows by more than 1 m/s RMS

G28_fail_closed.rule: uplink_ramps with a non-barycentric counted_doppler_model, a malformed entry or duplicate station names raise ValueError; a ramp not covering a count's transmit epochs raises ValueError at generation

G29_provenance.rule: metadata uplink_ramp_stations == ('Goldstone',) when that ramp is set

G30_production_partial_fd.rule: the ramped production Jacobian (radiometrics dispatch) vs central differences of re-propagated arcs (10 m / 1e-2 m/s) within 1e-6 of the row norm

G31_arc_epoch_independence.rule: the same ET ramp table on two passes with different et0 gives, for the same absolute receive epoch, values within 1e-9 m/s

G32_resolver_keeps_fields.rule: _resolve_range_rate_physics(cfg, count_interval_s) changes count_interval_s only (counted_doppler_model, station_state_method, uplink_ramps preserved); fails before the fix
